draftContext.markdown: Pieces 5 and 6 of the Mac workers plan (installs and the two-host run) are the next G4 gate. Core #637 (reusable takeover practice with immediate preflight) is the nearest unmerged draft PR on that path. Core #636/#635 (context refresh to CircusGreen scope) is owner-gated with no stated decision date — the existing AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md still present Frame framing to agents entering the repo. Core #634, #626, #627 have no stated disposition and no description of active work in this window's materials; each requires an explicit decision (actively working / parked until Phase N / closing). HouseholdAgentKit #1 is the highest-leverage open item in the fleet: no rung progression begins until it merges, and it is blocked on (a) resolution of 20+ review issues including P0 contract bugs and (b) the Q-BS-3 engine gate date decision (issue #21, owner-gated). The merge path and target date are not documented. ADR-0110 has no implementation slice open; the trigger for opening the first work register delivery PR is not named. Daily-logger #574 (qualification gate: exporter inside final image) must close before production cutover on the persistent service can be scoped; its current state is draft. The skill telemetry stream has been frozen since 2026-05-12 with no assigned owner and no open investigation path; the ambiguity between broken instrument and workflow problem is unresolved and materially affects what corrective action is appropriate. The default value and configuration surface for `presenceMs` are not documented in this window's materials — a sharp edge for fleet operators since misconfiguring it above 30 s causes workers to go stale before their next heartbeat. The operational response path for input-fetching failures at scale (dead-letter queue, stale-job accumulation, alert surface) is not documented.
